summary: Learn to design AI-assisted service workflows, improve resolution speed, and govern contact-centre automation. Book TrainingCred training.
lede: Agentic AI for customer service uses autonomous or semi-autonomous systems to plan tasks, use knowledge, and complete work within controlled workflows. This training is for customer service, contact-centre, and CX professionals who need to map customer intents, design retrieval-augmented knowledge workflows, and set tool-use, escalation, and human-review controls. It also covers measuring first-contact resolution, average handling time, and containment to assess service processes and report operational results.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who already work inside customer service, contact-centre, or CX operations and now need to apply agentic AI responsibly in live service workflows. It suits people who must balance speed, service quality, and governance while working with CRM systems, knowledge bases, workforce schedules, and escalation policies.
prerequisites: Recommended prerequisites include working knowledge of customer service or contact-centre operations, familiarity with CRM or helpdesk workflows, and basic comfort with service metrics such as average handle time and first-contact resolution. No coding is required for completion, although experience with process mapping, knowledge-base design, or analytics dashboards will help you move faster. Advanced agent orchestration concepts are introduced at an operational level, while hands-on exercises focus on practical workflow design, governance, and measurement rather than software engineering.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
